purpose: Audit whether the frozen active runtime consumers preserve the operative rules of one frozen knowledge-base reference.

scale.1: Major failures dominate; substantial repair is required.
scale.2: Partially correct but material defects remain.
scale.3: Correct and useful with only minor defects.
scale.4: Fully satisfies the anchored dimension with no material defect.

dimensions.description: Every material operative rule in the reference survives in the active consumer or the entrypoint; report material omissions precisely.

anchors.0: Absent or contradicts a hard task, evidence, or permission constraint.
anchors.1: Major omissions or wrong decisions; the result cannot be used reliably.
anchors.2: Partially satisfies this dimension but has a material unresolved defect.
anchors.3: Satisfies all material obligations of this dimension; only minor nonblocking weaknesses.
anchors.4: Complete, precise and proportionate support for this dimension, including applicable boundary behavior.
